digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge observability and CloudWatch monitoring
propositions: Reconcile Bridge run failures on GitHub Actions produce zero CloudWatch signal because the bridge runs outside the monitored host and existing observability probes cannot observe it
GitHub Actions workflows can publish CloudWatch metrics via OIDC but the rebar repo currently does not implement this capability

Bridge run failures must be published as a metric with value 1 on failure and 0 on success, authenticated via OIDC to a narrowly-scoped IAM role granting only cloudwatch:PutMetricData on the rebar/host namespace

A CloudWatch alarm on rebar/host:bridge_run_failures must trigger on the second failed pass within an hour to distinguish sustained outages from transient blips, while remaining invisible to total bridge absence (which is owned by the Heartbeat Canary)
